Abstract.AbstractText: In this article, we have presented a computational analysis on the structure and bonding of [Pd2Sn18]4- and illustrated that it serves as an interesting example of OMO-UMO mutual delocalisation with two identical [PdE9]2- fragments. We have also illustrated the alternative roles that could be played by an [ME9]2-/[E9]2- fragment, a simple L-type donor and a lone-pair acceptor.
